review.subject: Coffee face wash tube on coffee beans
review.summary: A single continuous shot of a coffee face wash tube standing on a pile of roasted beans while blurred beans fall in the foreground and background. The camera does a slow push-in over 8s; the tube lets the sheet show a gradual grow in frame.

beats.note: One continuous slow push-in on the tube with falling beans, warm brown backdrop and shallow depth of field.

shot_labels.note: Tube on bean pile, falling beans, slow push-in

learn: One 8.2s shot with easeInOut push-in is enough for a hero when the scene has its own motion.
Use falling blurred ingredients at foreground and background for depth around a still product.
Keep colours monochrome warm brown so the white label type pops.
Place the product dead-centre with the ingredient pile as the base, no text overlays.
